verdict.rationale: Orama ships a well-documented public API/SDK surface (JS/TS, Python, Rust SDKs, REST-like Cloud APIs), an llms.txt for AI discoverability, and a first-party MCP server so AI agents can interact with data programmatically; runtime probe confirms the JS API works in-process as documented. missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all candidate paths 404'd) and no independent third-party corroboration of API stability/versioning.
